status.en: 70 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Sanaa, Mokha and Marib.
status.nb: 70 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Sana'a, Mokha og Marib.

summary.en: Houthi forces have intensified attacks on Saudi Arabia, striking the Saudi Aramco headquarters, a Saudi airport and launching missiles toward Riyadh, while the Saudi-led coalition has intercepted some missiles and responded with airstrikes on oil facilities west of Sanaa and Houthi positions. The United Nations warned that Yemen has slipped back into full-scale war and that fighting threatens a humanitarian catastrophe, with aid delivery blocked for hundreds of thousands of people. Cholera cases have surged as the conflict worsens. The conflict produced 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Yemeni civil war (2014–present)
background.extract: The Yemeni civil war is an ongoing multilateral civil war that began in late 2014 mainly between the Rashad al-Alimi-led Presidential Leadership Council and the Mahdi al-Mashat-led Supreme Political Council, along with their respective supporters and allies. Both sides claim to constitute the official government of Yemen while the Presidential Leadership Council is recognized by the United Nations as the official government.
background.extractNb: Borgerkrigen i Jemen er en pågående konflikt i Jemen mellom Jemens internasjonalt tidligere anerkjente regjering, ledet av Abdrabbuh Mansur Hadi, og Houthi-bevegelsen. Begge sider har allierte, i form av styrker, våpenstøtte og informasjon, og krigen anses å være en del av den pågående konflikten mellom Saudi-Arabia og Iran.

posts.text:
Les Houthis du #Yémen mènent une guerre contre l'Arabie saoudite et contre le gouvernement reconnu par la communauté internationale. 

Depuis début septembre, ils gagnent du terrain. Ces derniers jours, ils se rapprochent de #Taïz, la troisième ville du pays
